artifacts.name: ghostBrickStore
artifacts.description: Zustand store with position, isValid, brickTypeId state; setGhostBrick() and clearGhostBrick() actions

artifacts.name: useGhostBrick hook
artifacts.description: Hook accepting { brickTypeId }, returning { onPointerMove, onPointerLeave }. Snaps to integer grid, checks isCellOccupied

artifacts.name: GhostBrick component
artifacts.description: R3F component rendering semi-transparent green (valid) or red (invalid) mesh at ghost position; null when hidden

artifacts.name: PointerEventCapture component
artifacts.description: Invisible R3F mesh covering ground plane, wires pointer events to useGhostBrick hook

artifacts.name: occupancyMap (updated)
artifacts.description: Added isCellOccupied(), occupyCell(), freeCell(), clearOccupancy() exports for grid occupancy tracking

summary.work_completed: Implemented 4 new modules and updated occupancyMap for FR-UI-003 Ghost Brick Placement Preview. ghostBrickStore (Zustand), useGhostBrick (hook with grid snapping and occupancy check), GhostBrick (R3F visual component), PointerEventCapture (invisible event capture mesh). All modules satisfy the 35 TDD test contracts from PR #86.
key_findings: ghostBrickStore uses Zustand create() with position/isValid/brickTypeId state and setGhostBrick/clearGhostBrick actions
useGhostBrick snaps pointer world position to nearest integer via Math.round() and checks isCellOccupied for validity
GhostBrick renders null when position is null; green (#00ff00) at 50% opacity for valid, red (#ff0000) for invalid
PointerEventCapture uses 100x100 invisible plane rotated to XZ ground plane
occupancyMap now exports isCellOccupied() using Set-based position key lookup

recommended_actions: Review PR for code quality, adherence to LLD, and test contract satisfaction
Verify all 35 test cases pass GREEN via vitest
Check that ghostBrickStore follows existing Zustand patterns in the codebase
Verify GhostBrick color constants match LLD specification
Confirm PointerEventCapture ground plane dimensions are appropriate
Review occupancyMap changes for backward compatibility
